title: The Clean shirt on the line
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：clean　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clean 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the painter wrote of ① a clean shirt on the line in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② cleaner than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the clean ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the cleanest shirt on the line anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too clean to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the clean ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a clean record in the office, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as clean as the record in the office they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was clean or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something clean, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite clean; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the clean ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, with great care, she wrote of another clean shirt on the line in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ cleaner than anybody had expected. ⑩ The cleanest record in the office in the whole studio, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the clean ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 干净（前置定语 a clean shirt on the line：1979 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件干净的衬衫）
B. adj. 干净／清白（比较级 cleaner than：文中两处，一处比晾绳上的衬衫，一处比预想）
C. adj. 干净／清白（最高级 the cleanest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 干净（表语 too clean to do：母亲觉得它太干净，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 清白（前置定语 a clean record in the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩清白的记录）
F. adj. 清白（同级比较 as clean as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室的记录相比）
G. adj. 清白（后置定语 something clean：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 清白（受程度副词修饰 quite clean：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a clean shirt on the line
the cleanest shirt on the line anybody
a clean record in the office
The cleanest record in the office in

answers.why: clean 意为“干净”，1979 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件干净的衬衫”，此处作前置定语 a clean shirt on the line。
clean 意为“干净”，此处用比较级 cleaner than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
clean 意为“干净”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最干净的一件，故用最高级 the cleanest shirt on the line。
clean 意为“干净”，母亲认为这件东西“太干净了，谁也用不上”，too clean to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
clean 意为“清白”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩清白的记录”，此处作前置定语 a clean record in the office。
clean 意为“清白”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室的记录一样清白”，同级比较用 as clean as。
clean 意为“清白”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“清白的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something clean。
clean 意为“清白”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当清白”，quite 修饰原级 clean。
clean 意为“清白”，1989 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要清白”，故用比较级 cleaner than。
clean 意为“清白”，母亲 1991 年说的是“整个画室里最清白的那一桩”，故用最高级 the cleanest record in the office。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件干净的衬衫。（a clean shirt on the line）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更干净。（cleaner than …）
母亲觉得它太干净，谁也用不上。（too clean to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩清白的记录。（a clean record in the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室的记录一样清白。（as clean as …）
到了 1986 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件清白的东西。（something clean）
answers: In 1979 the painter wrote of a clean shirt on the line in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was cleaner than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too clean to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a clean record in the office.
He said nobody would call it as clean as the record in the office they had once had.
By 1986 the catalogue asked for nothing but something clean.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 clean 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the painter wrote of a clean shirt on the line in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the cleanest shirt on the line in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too clean to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a clean record in the office, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite clean, and everybody laughed.
The clean ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
